title: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who are not in the 'Member
question: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who are not in the 'Member' position, have a t-shirt size of 'Large', and have incurred at least one expense that exceeds the average cost of all expenses associated with the 'Food' budget category.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.XCL_035,
    m.XCL_036,
    m.XCL_040
FROM member AS m
WHERE m.XCL_038 <> 'Member'
  AND m.XCL_039 = 'Large'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM expense AS e
      INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
      WHERE e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
        AND e.XCL_020 > (
            SELECT AVG(e2.XCL_020)
            FROM expense AS e2
            INNER JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
            WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Food'
        )
  )
